051573ebf5914ef08c20dcdd76a7e2d7.title: Full Detail and Paint Correction Standards
051573ebf5914ef08c20dcdd76a7e2d7.summary: Coppermill Motor Group requires a mandatory full detail and paint correction process for all retail-bound vehicles, separate from the Pre-Delivery Inspection. The procedure includes systematic washing, paint inspection, machine polishing based on visual grading, and interior/engine bay detailing.
highlights: Machine polish intensity is determined by a visual grade: two-stage for panels scoring below 7/10 and single-stage for 7/10 or above.
Ceramic top coats are mandatory for vehicles listed above $35,000, while others are at the site manager's discretion.
Mandatory documentation requires logging every panel with paint defects, interior treatments, and completion of the detail in the recon history.

8c59dfbde6ad496c9bda9b5aa6e5b16b.title: ADAS Calibration and Windscreen Replacement Protocol
8c59dfbde6ad496c9bda9b5aa6e5b16b.summary: Vehicles with forward-facing driver-assist cameras require specific windscreen replacement and recalibration procedures to ensure safety and regulatory compliance. Any windscreen replacement on Coppermill vehicles built since 2019 necessitates a logged calibration to prevent lane-position or distance-judgment errors.
highlights: Use only approved WS-4410 series parts for ADAS-equipped vehicles.
Verify camera mounting position via parts diagrams before ordering glass.
Complete static or dynamic recalibration immediately following windscreen installation.
A logged calibration result is mandatory to clear a PDI blocker.

eb50a7baf0424c80b5f0ba0c49a52091.title: Brake Pad and Rotor Service Standard
eb50a7baf0424c80b5f0ba0c49a52091.summary: This standard mandates comprehensive brake inspections for all intake vehicles and sets strict replacement criteria based on pad thickness and rotor condition. It emphasizes safety by prohibiting resurfacing and requiring the use of Meridian Brake Components.
highlights: Measures pad thickness on all four corners using calipers during intake inspection.
Mandatory replacement required for any brake pad measuring below 3mm.
Prohibits rotor resurfacing; replacements are mandatory if scoring exceeds 0.5mm or thickness falls below manufacturer minimums.
Utilizes Meridian Brake Components as the default supplier for all non-warranty brake replacements.

8cf42709ddf94899b287142aff5d43b4.title: Coppermill Motor Group PDI Checklist Requirements
8cf42709ddf94899b287142aff5d43b4.summary: The Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) serves as the final mandatory gate before a vehicle is cleared for customer delivery, ensuring all recon work is completed and verified.
highlights: A mandatory 10km road test covering city and highway speeds is required to ensure no warning lights, noises, or vibrations occur.
Technicians must verify fluid levels, tyre pressures based on door jamb placards, and functional testing of all lights, indicators, and the horn.
Specific items must be present, including the spare wheel/repair kit, service history/owner's manual, and a minimum of a quarter tank of fuel.
ADAS calibration status must be verified if any windscreen or camera-adjacent panels were serviced during the recon process.

f2f6a4dbb3634b94bac400567b4825f1.title: Tyre and Wheel Alignment Procedures
f2f6a4dbb3634b94bac400567b4825f1.summary: The Coppermill Motor Group requires consistent tyre maintenance and wheel alignment checks during intake and pre-delivery inspections to ensure vehicle safety and compliance.
highlights: Tyres with tread depth below 1.5mm must be replaced immediately.
Uneven tread wear mandates a suspension investigation before fitting new tyres to prevent recurring damage.
Four-wheel alignment checks are standard at intake and mandatory following any suspension component service.
Replacement tyres must meet or exceed the load and speed ratings specified on the vehicle's tyre placard.

c4d6a5f9246b4f1e8caf01098fe6d753.title: Toyota Fuel Pump Control Module Recall
c4d6a5f9246b4f1e8caf01098fe6d753.summary: Toyota RAV4 and HiLux models from 2022-2023 are subject to a safety recall due to a faulty fuel pump control module capacitor that can cause power loss. Affected vehicles must undergo a VIN lookup and potential module replacement before they can be cleared for delivery.
highlights: Faulty internal capacitors can cause intermittent loss of drive power under high engine load.
Vehicles must be verified via manufacturer VIN lookup, even if no symptoms are present.
Remedy requires physical inspection or replacement of the control module, as scans may not detect the fault.
This recall is a mandatory PDI blocker; vehicles cannot be delivered until the remedy is confirmed.

46bc63ce9dcd4b2295584db472f25ed9.title: Rear Differential Seal Recall Requirements
46bc63ce9dcd4b2295584db472f25ed9.summary: The Ford Ranger and Everest recall addresses premature seal degradation that can lead to oil leaks and differential failure under load. All affected vehicles require a mandatory inspection and follow-up, regardless of whether a current remedy is performed.
highlights: Perform a visual inspection for oil residue and check fluid levels on all affected build-window vehicles.
If residue or low fluid is detected, replace the output seal and top up the fluid to specification.
Schedule a mandatory follow-up inspection 90 days post-delivery for all affected stock.
Preventative seal replacement is recommended for vehicles used for towing and mandatory for demonstrator units.

771979ba6e814d14b90612873f7bd939.title: Mazda CX-5 Infotainment Update Procedure
771979ba6e814d14b90612873f7bd939.summary: The Mazda CX-5 infotainment software update addresses a Bluetooth reconnection issue affecting 2022-2023 models. Consultants are advised to verify the version during recon and proactively inform customers to ensure a positive ownership experience.
highlights: Verify software version via Settings > System > Software Version during recon.
Apply USB updates for versions below the current release to fix Bluetooth connectivity failures.
Update installation takes approximately 20 minutes and must be logged as a recon line item.
Proactively discuss the fix during delivery handover to build customer trust.

b3725ed991d345c2acbf815135ae60bd.title: Hyundai i30 Timing Chain Tensioner Inspection Protocol
b3725ed991d345c2acbf815135ae60bd.summary: The timing chain tensioner for 2020-2021 2.0L petrol Hyundai i30s requires a specific cold-start test to identify potential rattle issues.
highlights: Perform two cold starts with at least 4 hours between them to identify the specific rattle pattern.
If the rattle is present, replace the tensioner; otherwise, no action is required.
The fault is intermittent and cannot be reliably detected by a single warm test drive.

2d4d53f9a5754423a71ac8317d456f4d.title: Kia Sportage Airbag Control Unit Recall Remedy
2d4d53f9a5754423a71ac8317d456f4d.summary: Affected 2021-2022 Kia Sportage vehicles require a mandatory firmware update to the airbag control unit to correct an issue with impact-severity detection.
highlights: Firmware update recalibrates the impact-severity algorithm to ensure correct airbag deployment.
Process takes approximately 30 minutes using a diagnostic tool and does not require physical part replacement.
Vehicles must have the firmware checked and updated before delivery, as this is a hard PDI blocker.
Technicians must log the firmware version before and after the update, along with the results of the built-in self-test.

38a35945576f47e99b1b1ce4ce404562.title: DPF Regeneration Cycle Advisory and Handover Education
38a35945576f47e99b1b1ce4ce404562.summary: The Isuzu D-Max DPF regeneration service bulletin addresses soot accumulation caused by frequent short-trip usage, which is common in demonstrator vehicles. Technicians are advised to perform diagnostic checks and forced regeneration cycles during recon, followed by proactive customer education at handover.
highlights: DPF soot accumulation is considered normal diesel behavior rather than a vehicle fault.
Perform a diagnostic check and forced regeneration if soot levels exceed the advisory threshold.
Proactively educate customers that sustained highway driving is required for proper DPF maintenance to prevent unnecessary return visits.

1cea1a27372c413fabed763b964d7c00.title: Finance and Insurance Disclosure Policies
1cea1a27372c413fabed763b964d7c00.summary: Coppermill Motor Group enforces strict disclosure requirements and prohibited practices for all finance and insurance products offered during vehicle sales.
highlights: Mandatory disclosure of comparison rates, total loan costs, and any consultant or dealership commissions.
Clear communication regarding customer rights to independent finance and detailed coverage for add-on insurance products.
Prohibits bundling finance with vehicle pricing and pressuring customers to decide on products without considering documentation.

9334d86c6472480aa306bd37e0dc7233.title: PDI Sign-Off and Hold Compliance Standards
9334d86c6472480aa306bd37e0dc7233.summary: This document outlines the strict requirements for vehicle Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) sign-offs and the specific conditions that trigger mandatory, non-overrideable delivery holds.
highlights: Final delivery-ready sign-off requires two signatures: the performing technician and the service manager or dealer principal.
Non-overrideable PDI holds include open safety recalls, failed ADAS calibrations, and specific safety-critical maintenance issues.
Vehicles in PDI Hold status cannot be advertised, listed, or communicated as ready for delivery until all items are cleared and re-verified.

604613993e4e4f039ed952fca536b859.title: ADR Modification Disclosure Policy
604613993e4e4f039ed952fca536b859.summary: Coppermill Motor Group requires written disclosure of all aftermarket modifications that impact vehicle compliance, such as ride height, non-standard wheels, or electrical accessories.
highlights: Consultants must identify modifications during intake reconciliation to ensure timely disclosure.
Documentation must explicitly state if a compliance engineer's certificate is held or if certification is not held.
Required for items including suspension lifts, non-standard tyre combinations, aftermarket tow bars, and auxiliary lighting.

36eaa4ebd2de4792a3e72209ed31de69.title: Consumer Disclosure Requirements
36eaa4ebd2de4792a3e72209ed31de69.summary: Coppermill Motor Group requires written disclosures for consumer guarantee rights, cooling-off periods, and prior vehicle history for all retail sales.
highlights: Written notice of consumer guarantee rights is mandatory and cannot be waived.
Cooling-off disclosures must specify the exact business days and exercise process, not just a generic reference.
Structural repairs and repainted surfaces must be disclosed based on specific inspection thresholds.

bfc6a96a7bfe48f28a2af8049330f3ef.title: Radiant Auto Glass Supplier Overview
bfc6a96a7bfe48f28a2af8049330f3ef.summary: Radiant Auto Glass serves as Coppermill Motor Group's primary supplier for ADAS-compatible WS-4410 windscreens, maintaining a high calibration success rate despite a past bracket alignment issue.
highlights: Maintains over 95% first-pass static calibration success rate.
Addressed a Q1 batch issue with recessed camera brackets by implementing tighter quality control.
Standard lead times are 3 business days for in-range parts and 7-10 days for special orders.
Shim kits are available at the Riverside site to resolve alignment issues from the affected Q1 batch.

cb82118cd608457d90dfe17c3b4e0bec.title: TrackGrip Tyres Supplier Overview
cb82118cd608457d90dfe17c3b4e0bec.summary: TrackGrip Tyres serves as the primary supplier for Coppermill's fleet, offering reliable order accuracy while managing seasonal lead time fluctuations for heavy-duty ute fitments.
highlights: Consistent reliability in order accuracy with no compliance-relevant mis-ships in the last year.
Standard 2-3 day lead time for passenger and SUV tyres, increasing to 3-7 days for ute/heavy fitments.
Peak seasonal demand, particularly in summer, can extend ute-fitment lead times to 5-7 business days.

0daa1654c96144458a9a385446ab423d.title: Meridian Brake Components Supplier Overview
0daa1654c96144458a9a385446ab423d.summary: Meridian Brake Components serves as the default supplier for non-warranty brake replacements, maintaining a reliable performance record for passenger and SUV models.
highlights: Reliable performance with no reported premature wear or noise issues in the past year.
Standard lead time of two business days for common vehicle fitments.
Maintains on-site working stock of common pad and rotor combinations at both Riverside and Northgate locations.

bcb8819d80c34e239104937cdbf9b7c2.title: Solstice Paint and Coatings Performance Overview
bcb8819d80c34e239104937cdbf9b7c2.summary: Solstice Paint and Coatings has served as a reliable supplier for ceramic top coats since 2022, consistently meeting durability expectations with no product defects or customer comebacks. While the product requires a longer indoor cure time that occasionally impacts scheduling, it remains a standard application for high-value vehicles.
highlights: No instances of coating failure or water-spotting reported over the past 12 months.
Day-to-day supply availability is consistent, supported by quarterly bulk ordering.
Requires a 4-hour minimum indoor cure, which can cause scheduling friction during high-turnover periods at the Riverside site.

e0d96807fce54f96b8409d9739c78885.title: WS-4410 Windscreen Replacement and Calibration Requirements
e0d96807fce54f96b8409d9739c78885.summary: The WS-4410 series is the only approved windscreen for ADAS-equipped Coppermill fleet vehicles, requiring precise sub-part selection and mandatory post-installation calibration. Failure to properly calibrate the camera after replacement is a PDI blocker due to safety and compliance risks.
highlights: Always verify the exact sub-part number against the vehicle's build plate to ensure correct camera bracket geometry.
A logged static or dynamic ADAS calibration is mandatory following any WS-4410 windscreen fitment.
Some Q1 batch units feature a recessed bracket mount requiring a specific shim kit for correct alignment.
Using non-approved glass is the primary cause of failed static calibrations within the Coppermill fleet.

44582dbb9dfe45d4a9304d642b5fcbeb.title: BR-2210 Brake Pad Compatibility Overview
44582dbb9dfe45d4a9304d642b5fcbeb.summary: The BR-2210 series is intended for Coppermill fleet passenger and SUV models outside of manufacturer warranty, while heavy-duty vehicles require the BR-3300 range.
highlights: Compatible with specific passenger and SUV models including Toyota RAV4, Mazda CX-5, and Hyundai i30.
Must not be fitted to heavy-duty vehicles like the Ranger or HiLux, even if dimensions appear similar.
Specific sub-variant part numbers must be logged in the recon history due to differences in pad compounds.

ae0934860bfd448aa3f526023a155b32.title: TR-1180 Tyre Compatibility and Compliance
ae0934860bfd448aa3f526023a155b32.summary: The TR-1180 series maps Coppermill fleet models to approved TrackGrip Tyres based on placard load index and speed ratings. Proper compliance requires verifying the vehicle's specific door jamb placard rather than relying on existing, potentially non-compliant, tyre sizes.
highlights: Always reference the driver's door jamb placard instead of the previously fitted tyre size.
Ute and heavy SUV models (e.g., Ranger, HiLux) must use the higher load index band within the TR-1180 range.
Fitting passenger-band tyres to heavy models is a compliance violation under the Tyre and Wheel Alignment Standard.

74fe2f563f2a4f8a9f3b72a047ce1d18.title: Brake Maintenance Required for Stock CM-5102
74fe2f563f2a4f8a9f3b72a047ce1d18.summary: An intake inspection of the 2023 Toyota RAV4 GXL identified front brake pads below the safety threshold, necessitating a replacement of the front axle pads.
highlights: Front left and right brake pads measured 2.6mm and 2.8mm, falling below the mandatory 3mm replacement limit.
Recommend installation of BR-2210 pads for the front axle; rear pads remain within tolerance at over 6mm.
Rotors exhibit light scoring but remain within manufacturer thickness specifications.
Vehicle bodywork requires standard detailing to address a minor door edge chip.

9a22eea6414f4ca4bf145f2e856284c7.title: Recall Status: CM-5118
9a22eea6414f4ca4bf145f2e856284c7.summary: The 2022 Ford Ranger XLT (CM-5118) is affected by the rear differential seal recall, requiring immediate maintenance due to detected oil residue and low fluid levels.
highlights: Inspection confirmed light oil residue and fluid levels below specification.
Seal replacement and fluid top-up are mandatory before the vehicle can clear PDI.
Tyre tread depth is currently at 6mm across all positions, meeting safety tolerances.

8636afc4edd04e4cb9da616fe2c3224c.title: Recon Assessment for Mazda CX-5 (CM-5124)
8636afc4edd04e4cb9da616fe2c3224c.summary: The 2023 Mazda CX-5 Touring at the Riverside location requires an infotainment software update to resolve a Bluetooth reconnection issue. Aside from this update, the vehicle is in excellent condition with brakes and tires within tolerance and a high paint grade.
highlights: Identified a Bluetooth reconnection defect caused by outdated infotainment software.
Recommended applying the official software update before delivery to avoid customer troubleshooting.
Confirmed vehicle is in good condition with a 9/10 paint grade and healthy brakes and tires.

cfeef893aa6c478eb9c1b861d72461ff.title: Stock CM-5137 Recon Findings
cfeef893aa6c478eb9c1b861d72461ff.summary: The 2021 Hyundai i30 Active requires a timing chain tensioner replacement following a confirmed rattle during the required two-cold-start protocol. Front tyre replacement has been deferred as the 4mm tread depth remains within the discretionary threshold for the expected retail hold time.
highlights: Confirmed timing chain tensioner rattle on both cold starts requiring replacement.
Front tyre tread depth of 4mm deemed sufficient for short-term retail hold.
Odometer at intake logged at 31,200 km.

bf36d5f6d14a409c9529044dea2708c0.title: Recon Summary: Isuzu D-Max SX (CM-5145)
bf36d5f6d14a409c9529044dea2708c0.summary: The 2023 Isuzu D-Max SX demonstrator required a forced DPF regeneration due to excessive soot accumulation from short-trip usage. The issue has been resolved, and proactive customer education is recommended during handover.
highlights: DPF soot load was above threshold due to demonstrator short-trip usage.
Forced regeneration completed successfully, clearing the warning light.
Recommended including DPF maintenance education in the sale file for the customer.

af2061384c774d1fafecddb704259c10.title: Airbag Control Unit Firmware Update for CM-5150
af2061384c774d1fafecddb704259c10.summary: Stock CM-5150, a 2022 Kia Sportage SX, successfully underwent a required airbag control unit firmware update to comply with safety recall standards. The vehicle passed all post-update self-test sequences with no reported faults.
highlights: Confirmed eligibility for the airbag control unit recall and applied the necessary firmware update.
Verified system integrity via the built-in diagnostic self-test with no faults reported.
Complied with all documentation requirements, including logging firmware versions before and after the update.

5d7819501a5e41ba8c6c680c3846b68d.title: Stock CM-5163: 2023 Yamaha MT-07 Assessment
5d7819501a5e41ba8c6c680c3846b68d.summary: This 2023 Yamaha MT-07 demonstrator unit at the Riverside site has a low odometer reading of 1,400 km and is in good mechanical condition. It requires only a standard detail due to minor cosmetic scuffing on the right-side fairing.
highlights: Odometer reading is exceptionally low at 1,400 km.
Cosmetic-only scuffing from a low-speed drop; no mechanical or frame damage detected.
Brake fluid and chain tension are confirmed to be within specification.
Unit is cleared for sale following a standard detail; no mechanical reconnaissance holds required.

8c1c61786106414cbdbc2c1af42a9f2e.title: CM-5171 Vehicle Inspection Summary
8c1c61786106414cbdbc2c1af42a9f2e.summary: The 2021 Subaru Outback Sport (CM-5171) shows no mechanical issues, but requires a mandatory written disclosure of a past rear quarter panel repair due to paint depth readings.
highlights: Vehicle has a recorded paint depth of 74 microns on the rear left quarter panel, falling below the 80-micron disclosure threshold.
A prior minor repair from a low-speed carpark incident was disclosed during trade-in intake.
Per Consumer Guarantee policy, the repaint history must be disclosed to the next buyer in writing.

99c77efc80854e36a1bd5e6bafa7189e.title: Recall Remedy Completion for Stock CM-5184
99c77efc80854e36a1bd5e6bafa7189e.summary: Stock CM-5184, a 2023 Toyota HiLux SR5, successfully underwent the required fuel pump control module replacement to address a safety recall. Following the part replacement, the vehicle passed a mandatory 15km road test with no further power loss issues.
highlights: Confirmed and applied fuel pump control module recall remedy
Performed successful 15km post-remedy road test including full-throttle acceleration
Verified no ADAS camera or windscreen calibration was necessary
Logged remedy completion in the vehicle's recon history

485a7761d9e9424bb91bb9a07e1a5254.title: Windscreen Replacement Summary for Stock CM-5192
485a7761d9e9424bb91bb9a07e1a5254.summary: The 2022 Honda CR-V VTi-L underwent a successful windscreen replacement and ADAS calibration after sustaining damage during transport.
highlights: Replaced windscreen with WS-4410 glass due to a crack in the driver's line of sight.
Initial ADAS calibration failed due to a known Q1 batch bracket alignment issue.
Successfully resolved the alignment issue using a shim kit, ensuring a clean calibration result prior to PDI.

ec2fbb4985294c749d7641c7b137d48d.title: Recon Assessment for Stock CM-5205
ec2fbb4985294c749d7641c7b137d48d.summary: The 2023 Suzuki Swift GL+ at the Riverside site is a near-new demonstrator requiring minimal reconditioning. The vehicle is ready for a pre-delivery inspection once the standard full detail is completed.
highlights: Odometer at intake is 2,100 km with tyres and brakes well within tolerance.
A minor interior scuff on the driver's door card has been resolved via detail.
No compliance items were identified for this Speedy Blue hatch.

bff1069b47ea423c9aead06df7974709.title: Recon Summary for Stock CM-5213
bff1069b47ea423c9aead06df7974709.summary: The 2021 Ford Everest Trend (Stock CM-5213) underwent a successful inspection and preventative rear differential seal replacement despite showing no signs of leakage. This action was taken proactively in line with recall bulletin recommendations for tow-capable vehicles.
highlights: Vehicle identified within the affected build window for the rear differential seal recall.
Initial inspection confirmed a dry housing and fluid levels within specification.
Preventative seal replacement was performed to ensure safety and compliance.

0de80ef3cf214e998e86ec37e510bb6b.title: Reconnaissance Report: Stock CM-5226
0de80ef3cf214e998e86ec37e510bb6b.summary: The 2023 Kawasaki Ninja 650 is in showroom condition with only 800 km on the odometer. No mechanical issues were identified, requiring only a standard detail.
highlights: Extremely low mileage at 800 km.
Brakes, chain, and tyres verified to be within specification.
No mechanical findings reported during inspection.
Recommended for standard detailing.

f95d6b0a2b8b4445b8449072076703fe.title: Recon Assessment: Stock CM-5234
f95d6b0a2b8b4445b8449072076703fe.summary: The 2022 Mitsubishi Triton GLS shows rear tyre tread at 2mm with uneven wear patterns, indicating a suspension alignment issue. The four-wheel alignment check confirmed the rear toe is out of spec, requiring correction before new tyres are installed.
highlights: Rear tyre tread depth measured at 2mm with visible uneven wear.
Four-wheel alignment check confirmed rear toe is out of specification.
Alignment correction must be performed before installing new heavy-duty TR-1180 tyres.
Mandatory alignment check required when replacing tyres showing uneven wear.

f5440396f6604d84965b7f5b3c4a04ab.title: 2023 Toyota RAV4 GXL Overview
f5440396f6604d84965b7f5b3c4a04ab.summary: The 2023 Toyota RAV4 GXL is a dependable mid-size SUV designed for daily family utility and weekend travel, featuring a hybrid-ready platform.

highlights: Ideal for customers seeking a dependable vehicle that offers consistent performance.
Engineered for strong tray payload and segment-leading towing capabilities.

614a65251d6a438dadbd9d9131a8ede1.summary: The 2023 Mazda CX-5 Touring is a refined mid-size SUV known for its upmarket cabin, confident highway performance, and overall reliability. It is ideal for buyers who prioritize predictable running costs and strong dealer network support.
highlights: Features an upscale cabin design at an accessible price point.

highlights: Targets customers prioritizing reliability and low surprise maintenance costs over high performance.
Features class-competitive boot space and a long factory warranty for buyer peace of mind.

5895778c50cf483aa2bf0f7dc463e848.title: Recon Overview: Toyota RAV4 GXL (CM-5102)
5895778c50cf483aa2bf0f7dc463e848.summary: This Riverside-based 2023 Toyota RAV4 GXL requires front brake pad replacement and standard detailing, with no other mechanical issues identified during intake.
highlights: Front brake pads measured at 2.6mm and 2.8mm, requiring BR-2210 replacement.
Paint condition rated 8/10 with only a minor door edge chip noted.

6145b05616b44a18a0b6df7b27977716.title: Recon Documentation for Stock CM-5118
